rules.rule: Bottom navigation: 3-5 items, icons with labels, 56dp height, active item uses primary color fill, inactive items use muted icon only. Never put secondary actions here.
Top app bar: back/hamburger icon left, screen title center or left-aligned 20sp, action icons right (max 3 visible, rest in overflow menu). 56dp height standard.
Floating Action Button: bottom-right corner, 56dp diameter, always primary action for that screen. One FAB per screen maximum. Label for extended FAB.
Support swipe-back gesture for Android (edge swipe). List items support swipe-to-delete with undo snackbar. Pull-to-refresh with visible loading indicator.
Search: collapsed icon in toolbar that expands full-width on tap, with back/close button, live results below. Filters accessible as horizontal chips below search bar.
